answer: Each identity locks collateral in escrow, while coordinated equivocation is penalized at the cluster level: for k linked signers, pairwise fault exposure makes penalties scale as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Thus a swarm of disposable keys is no haven; its growing garden of identities magnifies the cost of proven coordination.
